## Texts and drawings (1)

- **E0419** (text, guess): 内务府 工程 乾隆三十六年 复查 (as quoted in S220). 乾隆三十六年十二月 1771 · S220 section 三; archive not seen · S220. http://iqh.ruc.edu.cn/old/qdhjylyjzx/xszl/ylfj/00baad8cc3da4c6a901378da7919d9a8.htm
  > 绮春园添建宫门、朝房、诸旗房间，并周围添砌虎石大墙，园内龙王庙添建涵洞……清理地面等项工程。
  New gate, offices and guard rooms of the banners after the garden became imperial. S220 glosses the 龙王庙 as in the later 延英论道 area, agreeing with S47. The 诸旗房间 fits the plan's guard house ?旗房 Z-QN07 by name only; this gate is an earlier one, so a guess.

**On the plan:** Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled ?旗房 (? marks an unread character), 3x1 cells. https://artmuseum.princeton.edu/collections/objects/138657
